## What's New

- Added the `GET /api/v1/events` endpoint for player join and leave events, with
  event IDs, timestamps, and `after_id` polling.
- Added Prometheus server tick-duration histogram and a counter for stalls of
  at least 100 ms.
- Added process CPU per core, whole-machine CPU, managed heap, and garbage
  collection metrics.
- Added server ZDO/object counts, ZDO send and receive rates, pending change
  queue, connected peers, and peer send-queue metrics.
- Added an availability metric so unreadable peer socket queues are not
  misreported as zero.

## Notes

- Event history is kept in memory for the current plugin session, up to 1,000
  entries.
- Whole-machine CPU reports `-1` until a baseline is available or when the
  platform counters cannot be read.
- Ping and packet-loss values are not exported because dedicated-server sockets
  do not reliably provide them.
